label: Teamtailor
terms_note: Career sites (*.teamtailor.com) with a public career-site API for listings; apply forms web-only.

endpoints.call: every Teamtailor career site publishes public feeds (GET https://{company}.teamtailor.com/jobs.rss → application/rss+xml, /jobs.json → application/feed+json, live-verified on career.teamtailor.com) us
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: docs.teamtailor.com is a JavaScript app that rendered no text (also via r.jina.ai) — auth / rate-limit wording not read; docs.teamtailor.com is a JavaScript app that rendered no text (also via r.jina.ai) — auth / rate-limit wording not read; api.teamtailor.com answered 406 without the required headers (Authorization: Token token=…, X-Api-Version). Career-site feeds are public by design (career-site syndication). No candidate apply endpoint without the company key.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Teamtailor API key with the Public scope (read), created at https://app.teamtailor.com/app/settings/integrations/api-keys; sent as `Authorization: Token token=<key>`.

config_fields.name: api_host
config_fields.help: Teamtailor API host for the account's data stack: api.teamtailor.com (EU stack) or api.na.teamtailor.com (NA stack).

me.note: Verified with a one-job list, which a Public-scope key can read ('Can read all public data, for example, jobs, departments, and locations').

search.note: JSON:API list of the key owner's OWN published public jobs (GET /v1/jobs, filter[status]=published, filter[feed]=public), not a cross-company search. Filters take division/department/role/location ids and tags only, so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. Paging: page[number] and page[size] ('Default: 10, max: 30'); total = meta.record-count. Requests carry the required 'X-Api-Version' header (20240904). created-at 'Requires admin permission' and is null for a Public key; locations/department are relations (not included), and pitch, remote-status, employment-type, salary-time-unit, end-date and links.careersite-job-apply-url are in raw. Rate limit: '50 requests every 10 seconds' (429).

get_posting.note: GET /v1/jobs/{id} 'Retreive a specific job' as a JSON:API document {data: {id, attributes, links, relationships}}.

not_offered.apply: POST /v1/job-applications (Create job application) needs an Admin-scope key ('Can create new jobs, candidates and job applications'), i.e. the employer's credential; candidates apply via links.careersite-job-apply-url.
not_offered.list_messages: The API reference (Postman collection behind https://docs.teamtailor.com/) has no messages or conversations resource.
